input.claim_text: On 12 August 2023 we came home from a weekend away to find our back sliding door forced open and the house ransacked. They took my husband's laptop, my jewellery box with my engagement ring and grandmother's necklace, and a PlayStation 5 with several games. Our policy number is HM2287451. We haven't had a chance to get a full quote yet but I'd estimate it's all worth around $9,500.

output.answer:
Based on the excerpts provided, here's what applies to theft/burglary cover for stolen contents and jewellery:

## General Theft Cover Requirements

For **Contents in transit/storage** cover, theft is only covered if it follows **violent or forced entry** [NRMA Home PDS, page 19].

Similarly, for the storage costs/temporary accommodation benefit context, the policy states theft or attempted theft is **not** covered "unless the theft is from a secure building or room within a building with walls and a roof and follows forced and violent entry to that building" [NRMA Home PDS, page 23].

## Jewellery and Watches - Specific Definition

**Jewellery and Watches** means watches, jewellery items and medals, but **excludes** a mobile device with a screen display or a smart watch [NRMA Home PDS, page 11; NRMA Home PDS, page 25]. Note that limits apply to what is paid for these items as General Contents [NRMA Home PDS, page 11].

## Optional Portable Contents/Valuable Contents Benefit (Jewellery and Watches)

If you have specifically insured "Jewellery and Watches" as a group of Portable Contents (with a Sum Insured shown on your Certificate of Insurance), the policy will cover items that are **Accidentally lost, stolen or damaged** during the Period of Insurance, **anywhere in the world** [NRMA Home PDS, page 25].

Payment limits under this optional benefit are:
- Up to **$10,000** for any individual item, unless separately listed with its own Sum Insured (in which case up to that specified Sum Insured), if lost, stolen or damaged **within Australia or New Zealand** [NRMA Home PDS, page 26]
- Up to the **Sum Insured for the group** of Portable Contents (including separately listed items) if lost, stolen or damaged within Australia or New Zealand [NRMA Home PDS, page 26]
- Up to **$10,000 in total for all items** [NRMA Home PDS, page 26] — though the excerpt is cut off here, so I cannot confirm the exact context/conditions attached to this final limit.
